messages.content: How many heads can I get after tossing 3 coins?

message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, each coin can land either heads (H) or tails (T).  
The total number of possible outcomes is \(2^3 = 8\).

The number of heads you can obtain ranges from none at all to all three:

| Number of Heads | Example Outcome |
|-----------------|-----------------|
| 0               | T T T           |
| 1               | H T T           |
| 2               | H H T           |
| 3               | H H H           |

So, after tossing three coins, you can get **0, 1, 2, or 3 heads**.
